name: my-02--grok-4-7
question: Do Malaysian employers with fewer than five employees have to pay the national minimum wage, and from when?
answer: Yes, Malaysian employers with fewer than five employees must pay the national minimum wage to all their employees. This applies to every private-sector worker regardless of company size. The requirement has been in force since 1 January 2016 (initially RM920 per month) and the current rate is RM1,500 per month.
